name: Bass Hunter
review:
Bass Hunter is a 3x5 fishing slot with 10 paylines. Cash Fish carry values, Jackpot Fish hold bigger prizes, and Mystery Fish hide surprises, while the Hunter Respin feature keeps the collecting going.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.19%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
